mapper.insert: INSERT INTO chat_rooms (user_id, contractor_id, estimate_request_id) VALUES (#{userId}, #{contractorId}, #{estimateRequestId})
mapper.select: SELECT r.id, r.user_id, r.contractor_id, r.estimate_request_id, r.last_message, r.last_message_at, r.created_at, u.nickname AS user_nickname, c.company_name AS contractor_name FROM chat_rooms r JOIN users u ON u.id = r.user_id JOIN contractors c ON c.id = r.contractor_id WHERE r.id = #{id}

SELECT r.id, r.user_id, r.contractor_id, r.estimate_request_id, r.last_message, r.last_message_at, r.created_at, u.nickname AS user_nickname, c.company_name AS contractor_name FROM chat_rooms r JOIN users u ON u.id = r.user_id JOIN contractors c ON c.id = r.contractor_id WHERE r.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY COALESCE(r.last_message_at, r.created_at) DESC
